title: Got Dropped into a Ghost Story, Still Gotta Work
altTitles: Even If I Fall Into a Ghost Story, I Still Have to Go to Work
Even after Getting Dropped into a Creepypasta, I Still Have to Show Up for Work
Even if I fall into a ghost story, I still have to go to work
description: After attending a pop-up event for a modern fantasy series he loves, Kim Soleum suddenly transmigrates into that very world. Instead of becoming a hero, he wakes up as a newly hired employee of Daydream Inc., a powerful corporation with excellent benefits and a terrifying job. Using his knowledge of the world's lore, Soleum tries to rise through the company while surviving deadly ghost stories, supernatural anomalies, and mysterious forces. His greatest wish is simply to return home alive.
author: Baek Deok-su
